text:
Tess K: Need a fast-track approval for a Sr Eng offer. Autopick put band 5 but manager signed band 6. Candidate is relocating and needs to accept by 2026-09-01 or will go with competitor. Any emergency flow?
Maya S: Share comp ask numbers please.
Tess K: Manager approved base $210k, band5 cap is $185k. Discussed $20k sign-on. Total comp ~230k.
Jordan L: Budgeted headcount exists but uplift exceeds delegated limit. We normally need comp committee + finance. Can we do a provisional sign-on while committee reviews?
Finance Ops: Provisional sign-on OK if exec sponsor provides a stamp and procurement/P.O. can be queued. Also check benefits cutoff for September payroll (2026-08-28).
Tess K: Candidate's requested start 2026-09-03 (relocation week). Manager says losing them delays roadmap.
Maya S: Option: contingent offer at band5 max + one-time relocation/sign-on now; conditional uplift to band6 retroactive to payroll start if committee approves within 60 days. Needs exec sponsor.
PeopleOpsBot: Created approval ticket AW-55678. Status: submitted -> committee review pending. Link: https://internal.redwood/approvals/AW-55678
RecruiterBot: Candidate was briefed on contingent plan and is willing to accept if we secure exec sponsor.
Jordan L: I'll escalate to VP Eng (N. Park) for exec sponsor. Also add market comp notes and 3-month performance checkpoint to the ticket.
VP Eng: I can provide provisional exec stamp provided comp-committee votes within the timeframe. Proceed with contingent offer.
Finance Ops: Confirming provisional funding is available. Please include PO request in AW-55678 and note the payroll/enrollment split if payroll isn't live by 9/03.
Tess K: Drafting offer, including split start language. Snippet below:
```Offer AW-55678
Base: $210,000
Sign-on: $20,000 (one-time, includes relocation)
Band: provisional band6 pending committee approval
Start: 2026-09-03 onboarding remote / payroll & benefits effective 2026-09-10
Note: If uplift approved within 60 days, base will be adjusted retroactively to payroll start.```
Maya S: Add clause re background check completion and that relocation reimbursement is contingent on employment start date.
Tess K: Added. Uploading final draft to AW-55678.
PeopleOpsBot: AW-55678 update: reviewer assigned (C. Alvarez). Target review ETA: 18 hours.
Jordan L: Thanks. If committee approves, procurement needs 48h for PO. Please keep candidate updated on timeline.
RecruiterBot: Candidate verbally accepted contingent offer; signed docs pending.
PeopleOpsBot: AW-55678 status -> comp-committee approved at 1768880015. Finance review requested.
Finance Ops: Reviewed, funding confirmed. Sent PO request to procurement and marked ticket approved pending PO number.
Tess K: Offer sent formally, candidate accepted and signed. Uploading signed PDF shortly. :tada:
RecruiterBot: AW-55678 closed pending PO confirmation and payroll activation.
